assessed_not_integrated.status: ASSESSED-NOT-INTEGRATED (revisit when a measured claim-triplet recall advantage is shown on the engine's own records)

assessed_not_integrated.assessment: search-augmented fact verification ([[2]]) needs a live search API per atomic fact — the engine's retrieval fabric already does evidence retrieval with typed provenance; the atomic-fact decomposition would duplicate the mechanism-support instrument's relation checks
assessed_not_integrated.status: ASSESSED-NOT-INTEGRATED (revisit for the P5 post-cutoff rediscovery slice if its T2 citation-resolving retrieval needs per-fact verification)
